description: Three people sustained serious injuries in a fire that broke out at a seven-story building in central Seoul on Saturday, while seven others suffered minor injuries, mostly foreigners. description: Unlike the original play by William Shakespeare, the protagonists in director Ko Sun-woong’s reinterpretation, “King Lear: An Apocrypha,” do not meet a tragic end. The aging king still dies in the end, but only after defeating the villains. Cordelia, Lear’s youngest daughter and the only one who remains loyal to him, survives and looks toward a new love with Edgar, the son of Gloucester, who is unjustly cast out by his father. title: Director didn’t like ending of 'King Lear.' Here’s how he changed it
